title: 机器学习与生成式AI项目合集
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了使用Python构建的机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI与AI自动化项目，涵盖AI智能体、LLM应用、NLP、计算机视觉、API及自动化工具，代码整洁可扩展，旨在解决真实业务问题。
summary_en: A GitHub repository featuring Python-based machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and AI automation projects, including AI agents, LLM apps, NLP, computer vision, APIs, and automation tools with clean, scalable code for real-world business challenges.
